global_layoffs.description: Meta eliminated about 8,000 positions and canceled 6,000 planned hires while reorganizing around major artificial-intelligence infrastructure spending and shifting staff toward AI-related roles.
Vodafone Germany announced a restructuring of about 2,300 roles (including relocations), citing simpler structures, more AI and stronger competitiveness.
Qantas will cut about 850 jobs in an overhaul that includes AI-driven automation of back-office work.
Umicore announced about 350 job reductions in Belgium and cited AI among its reasons, alongside a EUR 450 million growth investment plan.
Gainsight cut about 270 jobs, with its CEO citing the changing future of SaaS and customer success in the age of AI.
Axonius plans to cut 66 jobs globally, including 46 in Israel, and declared the cuts AI-related.

gulf_mena_automation.description: Emirates NBD became the first MENA bank to deploy OpenAI GPT models on in-country infrastructure, for customer experience, risk, financial-crime prevention, process automation and staff productivity; no job figures disclosed.

saudi_policy_updates.title: Saudization rate raised to 35% for 94 technical engineering professions
saudi_policy_updates.description: HRSD and the Ministry of Municipalities and Housing raised the Saudization rate for 94 technical engineering professions from 30% to 35% in private establishments with five or more workers, effective 9 May 2027.

saudi_policy_updates.title: Phased increase of the Nitaqat full-worker salary threshold to SAR 5,000 then SAR 6,000
saudi_policy_updates.description: The minimum monthly salary for a Saudi employee to count as one full worker toward Saudization rates rises from SAR 4,000 to SAR 5,000 on 2027-04-25 and to SAR 6,000 on 2028-04-25; HRDF Employment Support aligns its minimum supported wage on the same two steps. It is a counting threshold, not a general minimum wage.
saudi_policy_updates.source: Saudi Press Agency via Saudi Gazette; EY Tax News (https://taxnews.ey.com/news/2026-2304-saudi-arabia-raises-minimum-nitaqat-salary-threshold-for-saudi-employees)

ai_workforce_signals.headline: Meta shifts workforce toward AI infrastructure
ai_workforce_signals.description: Meta eliminated about 8,000 positions, canceled 6,000 planned hires, and increased its focus on AI infrastructure. The restructuring is also moving thousands of employees into AI-related roles while reducing staffing elsewhere.

ai_workforce_signals.headline: AI-attributed US job cuts reach 121,401 through October
ai_workforce_signals.description: Challenger, Gray & Christmas counts 121,401 US job cuts attributed to AI from January to October 2026, more than double the 54,836 recorded for all of 2025, though AI's share of announced cuts has fallen since August.

ai_workforce_signals.headline: Tech layoffs pass 206,000 workers in 2026
ai_workforce_signals.description: TrueUp's tracker records 206,817 tech workers affected across 712 layoff events through 13 November 2026, even as companies expand AI spending.

ai_workforce_signals.headline: Saudi tech hiring slows, AI-management skills at a premium
ai_workforce_signals.description: Enterprise reports hiring is slowing across Saudi Arabia's tech sector while demand stays highest for people who can manage AI (data engineers, cloud architects, cybersecurity), with some repetitive jobs handed to AI.

ai_workforce_signals.headline: AI roles are 4% of Saudi job postings
ai_workforce_signals.description: Alion's AI Hiring Index counts 5,774 live postings from 672 employers in Saudi Arabia and finds about 4% are AI roles (edition of 13 November 2026).

ai_workforce_signals.headline: Saudi engineering Saudization quota rises to 35%
ai_workforce_signals.description: The higher quota for 94 technical engineering professions from May 2027 adds a localization constraint on firms that plan to automate or restructure technician roles.

weekly_stats.notable_trend: AI is increasingly named alongside restructuring in layoff announcements (Vodafone, Qantas, Umicore, Gainsight), yet Challenger data shows its share of stated US reasons has fallen since August; in Saudi Arabia the week's signal is regulatory (a 35% engineering Saudization quota from May 2027) and a slowing but AI-skill-hungry hiring market.
weekly_stats.data_note: Manual update 15 Nov 2026; YTD figures from TrueUp (tech layoffs) and Challenger (US AI-attributed cuts), different methodologies.
